name: Thomas Jefferson University crystallography core: Formulatrix NT8 with LCP components (NIH S10; 2019)
brief: A cancer-centre X-ray crystallography core replaces two failing crystallization robots with a nanolitre-volume drop-setting liquid handler equipped to pipette viscous lipidic-cubic-phase solutions for membrane-protein work.

cost.excludes_note: NIH S10 award for one drop setter with LCP components; the ~$11,500/year service contract is funded separately by the university and excluded.

notes: Out-of-sample: found after the cost model was frozen at commit 02d7678 and scored blind against it (results in docs/validation.md). Later model or catalog changes do not count as out-of-sample for this case. price_basis=configured, from the wording "a new NT8 crystallization robot equipped with components dedicated to pipetting viscous solutions in Lipidic Cubic Phase (LCP)" (options included). Verified 3 Oct 2026 via NIH RePORTER API (1S10OD023479-01A1, award_amount 93950; https://reporter.nih.gov/project-details/9699865). Quote: "we request funds to acquire a new NT8 crystallization robot equipped with components dedicated to pipetting viscous solutions in Lipidic Cubic Phase (LCP)." 1 of 1 items maps to formulatrix_nt8 (exact). Independent of the catalog NT8 source (NIH NHLBI 2018 PO).
